description:
Valid attributes and values for `wintraits_evaluar_concepto` and for the optional `atributos` of
`wintraits_diagnosticar_producto` in a category. `instrucciones_extraccion` says exactly how to read them from a
listing.

Args:
    categoria: subcategory (see wintraits_categorias_disponibles; e.g. "serums").
    pais: country code (see wintraits_categorias_disponibles; e.g. "ES").
    lang: "es" (default) or "en". The keys and values to send back are always the Spanish ids.

Free and unlimited during the beta (until 2027-01-31). Gratis y sin límite durante la beta (hasta el 31-ene-2027).
name: wintraits_opciones_concepto
